recommendation: Keep v53 unchanged while waiting for the first attributable eligible lifecycle. Current bounded evidence favors correct selectivity over a hidden entry failure and does not support relaxing any trigger.

friction_contract.interpretation: Counterfactual closes below zero after 13 bps are not evidence that an omitted entry would have been profitable.

hulk_expansion_short_robust_v3|BTC.assessment: No evidence that the absent expansion trigger suppressed a robust short opportunity in this prefix.

hype_breakout_compression_alignment_bidi.assessment: Removing the canonical breakout onset would have admitted many repeated near-misses whose independent short-horizon economics were negative. The only positive mean is six 60-minute paths and becomes negative after removing the largest winner, so it does not justify relaxation.

liquidity_sweep_long_1h_stop60_target60_.assessment: The missing sweep condition filtered negative counterfactual outcomes across every measured horizon; relaxing it would be contrary to this prefix.

analysis.supported_hypothesis: The zero-trade prefix is more consistent with selective triggers avoiding weak opportunities than with a technical entry failure.
why_not_high: The run is only about 14.3 hours and has no eligible events or completed lifecycles.
Counterfactual close marks are diagnostic and do not reproduce full strategy stop and exit paths.
Repeated poll evaluations are correlated; only explicitly labeled independent outcomes are used for near-miss conclusions.
A selective strategy can still be unprofitable when its rare full trigger finally occurs.

alternatives_considered.reason: Short-horizon one-blocker outcomes are negative and the six-path 60-minute mean is largest-winner dependent.
Every measured one-blocker horizon is negative after estimated friction.

alternatives_considered.option: Assume no trades proves a runtime bug
alternatives_considered.reason: All routes evaluate, readiness metrics are populated, data coverage is complete, and no entry-timing or routing breach is observed.

validation_still_required: Capture the first eligible intent and reconcile decision, route, submission timestamp, venue acknowledgement, fill, stop, funding, exit reason, fees, slippage, and net PnL.
Compare that lifecycle against its frozen modeled contract and the no-action baseline.
Continue causal missed-opportunity measurement; reassess only if omitted paths repeatedly clear realistic costs without largest-winner dependence.

falsifiers: An eligible provider evaluation produces no action or explicit withheld reason.
A submitted action exceeds its configured decision-age limit or binds the wrong strategy, symbol, side, sizing, stop, or exit contract.
Repeated independent omitted paths clear realistic costs with stable positive ex-largest economics.
The first attributable v53 lifecycles materially underperform their frozen assumptions after observed friction.
highest_value_next_investigation: Audit the first exact attributable v53 live lifecycle end to end; no active parameter change is currently evidence-supported.
